label: Clear
description: The forecast estimates no cloud cover.

label: Mostly clear
description: A small part of the sky is forecast to be covered by clouds.

label: Partly cloudy
description: Clouds are forecast across about a quarter to half of the sky.

label: Mostly cloudy
description: Clouds are forecast across most of the sky, with some clearer areas.

label: Very cloudy
description: Nearly all of the sky is forecast to be covered by clouds.

label: Overcast
description: The forecast estimates the whole sky to be covered by clouds.
